_comment: P3G.2 (#22) PR-blocking gate baseline. pass_rate is (passed / (passed + failed)) among NON-xfail cases for the category, from a clean `pytest evals/ -m "not integration"` run -- see evals/conftest.py's pytest_sessionfinish hook and evals/runner/gate.py. Regenerate by running the suite and updating a category's pass_rate deliberately (in its own commit, with a reason) whenever an intentional, reviewed change lowers it -- never to silence an unexplained regression.

citation_present._note: #81: flipped the issue #47 semantic-support gate ON and re-recorded against the live qwen3-8b-q5 engine, this time also capturing the support-judge's SemanticSupportJudgement call for every already-provenance-valid guideline_chunk citation -- 'verified' now means provenance AND semantic support, not just provenance. 10 of 12 cases got a fresh live draw; 2 could not be cleanly re-recorded (each live attempt reached a real planner/answer turn but then failed the claim-extraction decode after exhausting retries) and are left unchanged, pre-#81/gate-off: dual-antiplatelet-question (3 attempts) and statin-ck-myopathy-question (the SAME case #58 already documented as unrecordable). runner.pipeline.needs_semantic_support explicitly excludes both from the gate this cycle. Only 2 of the 12 cases pass non-xfail: bp-stage2-question (a real citation, judge-confirmed supported -- the one clean gate-ON pass) and dual-antiplatelet-question (carried over gate-off, NOT re-judged -- see its case file's comment, do not read this as a 2nd gate-ON pass). The other 10 are documented xfail: statin-liver-monitoring-question is the headline case issue #81 targeted -- re-recorded, still contradicts its cited quotes, and the judge correctly calls both its citations not_supported (verdict partially_verified); metformin-renal-monitoring-question is a genuine near-miss where the judge affirms a real citation as supported but an unrelated stripped claim still holds the verdict at partially_verified (a 2nd judge-confirmed-supported citation, just not a fully passing case); a1c-target-question, hypertension-lifestyle-followup-question, lithium-nsaid-question, renal-function-ace-question, and warfarin-antibiotic-question regressed on THIS draw for reasons unrelated to the gate (no citation surfaced, turn-budget exhaustion, or dropped source refs -- each case's PRIOR recording passed or near-missed differently; the gate never got a chance to act since no valid citation reached it); nsaid-ace-inhibitor-question and lipid-panel-ldl-question reproduce the same already-documented chart-data-only pattern from #58; statin-ck-myopathy-question is unchanged from #58. pass_rate is 1.0 because CategoryStats.pass_rate excludes xfailed cases from its denominator (2 passed / (2 passed + 0 failed) among the non-xfail cases) -- this baseline guards those 2 from regressing; it does NOT mean 12/12, or even 6/12, pass. See docs/MODEL_AND_HARDWARE_SELECTION.md for the full honest reconciliation.
